evals.prompt: Scaffold a Vite React app with Saudi Soft: shadcn init, lucide, Soft theme bridge, RTL Arabic, dark mode toggle. Then build a settings form with full name, email, and notification toggles with validation.
evals.expected_output: Soft theme applied, lucide icons, FieldGroup/Field forms, semantic Soft tokens, gap-* spacing. No sidebar required for settings-only.
expectations: Uses lucide-react only (iconLibrary lucide)
Applies Soft theme bridge markers or saudi-soft apply-theme
Uses FieldGroup and Field instead of raw div space-y
Uses data-invalid / aria-invalid for validation
Uses gap-* not space-y-*; semantic colors not bg-green-600
No manual dark: brand color overrides
Does not force app shell / sidebar for a settings form alone

evals.prompt: Create a dialog for editing a user profile with avatar, name, bio, Save/Cancel with icons — Saudi Soft / lucide.
evals.expected_output: DialogTitle, Avatar+AvatarFallback, data-icon, lucide imports, Soft semantic tokens.
expectations: Includes DialogTitle
Avatar includes AvatarFallback
Icons use data-icon; no size-4 on icons inside Button
Imports from lucide-react only
Uses asChild or render per project base

evals.prompt: Dashboard with 3 Soft-styled stat cards (primary/chart tokens), Badge deltas, Skeleton loading — Saudi Soft.
evals.expected_output: KPI Soft recipe: from-primary/10 gradient, bold value without CardTitle, muted labels, Badge deltas, Skeleton, gap-*.
expectations: KPI cards use from-primary/10 (or Soft tint) gradient surface — not plain default CardTitle blocks
Stat value is text-2xl or text-3xl font-bold without CardTitle
Label uses text-sm text-muted-foreground
Badge for deltas; semantic Soft tokens not raw emerald/red
Skeleton instead of custom animate-pulse
gap-* and size-* conventions

evals.prompt: Chat conversation with MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, Marker — Saudi Soft lucide.
evals.expected_output: Registry chat primitives, Soft tokens, lucide.
expectations: Uses MessageScroller family for scroll
Uses Message + Bubble for rows
Uses Attachment and Marker appropriately
Semantic Soft colors; lucide icons

evals.prompt: Build an Arabic RTL Soft dashboard app shell: sidebar 280px with active pill, 64px topbar with theme capsule (sun/moon ring-primary), page header with 48px icon tile, three gradient KPI cards, and two hub quick-action cards.
evals.expected_output: App shell + page header + KPI + hub recipes from Soft references; Soft tokens; lucide; RTL logical spacing.
expectations: Sidebar uses Soft width tokens (~280px expanded)
Active nav has start pill / primary-subtle treatment
Topbar height ~64px with theme capsule ring-2 ring-primary on active
Page header includes rounded-xl bg-primary/10 icon tile
Three KPI cards with Soft gradient tint and bold values without CardTitle
Hub cards with icon tile and hover border-primary/40 or bg-primary/5
RTL dir and logical ms/me/ps/pe spacing; lucide only

evals.prompt: The client rejected Soft green. Explicitly rebrand to a red brand ladder (primary around #B42318). Soft theme is already applied; dashboards use bg-primary and from-primary/10.
evals.expected_output: Edit only the Soft theme SA ladder (light + dark) in the theme block / theme-bridge; do not rewrite page components; gradients stay on var(--sa-*).
expectations: Changes limited to Soft theme markers or theme-bridge SA ladder values
Does not rewrite dashboard/page TSX just to change hue
Gradients remain derived from var(--sa-*) after ladder update
Follows rebrand.md / explicit-request policy

evals.prompt: Existing large React app with shadcn, hundreds of screens, many bg-emerald-* classes, no Soft theme yet. User asks to adopt Saudi Soft.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks theme-only vs Soft-native for new UI vs full migration before bulk changes; does not rewrite all pages by default.
expectations: Asks user to choose theme-only / Soft-native new work / full migration
Does not default to rewriting the entire legacy UI
Theme-only path uses apply-theme without mass page rewrites
